user.title: Connect your station
user.description:
Enter the ingest ID and key shown when your station was created.

No station yet? Create one at {signup_url}, then come back.

measurements.title: Which entity feeds which measurement
measurements.description: Leave a measurement empty if your station does not report it. One entity per measurement.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the new station key
reauth_confirm.description: The previous key stopped working. Generate a new one on the station's settings page and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The station ID or key was not accepted. Check both, and note that generating a new key immediately invalidates the old one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MeteoVeo. Your credentials were not tested; try again shortly.
error.unknown: Something went wrong that we did not anticipate. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.
